stem.en: About 100 kg of air presses on your palm, yet you do not feel it. Why?

text.en: Skin cannot sense any pressure at all.

feedback.en: Skin feels a push easily. This push is balanced from inside.

text.en: Air presses from all sides, and the pressure inside the body balances it.

feedback.en: Yes. The pushes from outside and inside cancel.

text.en: The air is too thin to press on anything.

feedback.en: Air does press: about 1 kg on every square centimetre.

text.en: The air only presses on the ground, not on people.

feedback.en: Air presses on everything it touches, including you.

explanation.en: Air presses on us from all sides, and our bodies exert a counter-pressure. The pressure inside the body equals the atmospheric pressure and cancels the pressure from outside, so we feel nothing.

hints.en: Think about what is happening on both sides of your skin.
Pressure inside the body is about the same as outside it.
